I appreciate you letting me know about the account merge, but I can only access orders for your current account, c-1000. I'm not able to retrieve orders from c-1001, even if those accounts have been merged.

If your old orders from c-1001 should now be visible under c-1000 after the merge, I'd be happy to list all the orders on your current account. Would you like me to show you the orders for c-1000 instead?
